name: Microscaling PTQ research harness
notable_features: Reimplements GPTQ, AWQ and SmoothQuant inside one harness so the algorithms are comparable
Reports WikiText-2-test and C4 perplexity plus 8-task zero-shot accuracy in a single table
MX formats at block size 128 (and a 16-wide ablation in the appendix)
hardware_caveats: Not a serving runtime. Results are fake-quant / simulated formats: nothing here was run on MXFP4 or MXFP8 hardware
best_for: apples-to-apples comparison of INT vs MX formats and of PTQ algorithm combinations
avoid_for: latency, or any claim about hardware MX kernels
notes: The single most useful source in this repo for the 'is that delta real or is that algorithm choice' question, because it holds model, harness, calibration set, group size and format fixed while varying only one thing. Its own finding that GPTQ and AWQ are synergistic but AWQ+SmoothQuant is not is a methodology warning in its own right.
